posts.facebook:
Shelby County, thank you for the trust you place in the people down the street.

Readers of The Light and Champion named Morrison Insurance Best Insurance Agency in the 2026 Best of the Best awards. That is a kindness we do not take lightly.

Thank you to everyone who voted, and to the neighbors who let us help with an everyday question or a change in their lives. Taking good care of people is still the work that matters.

Thank you, too, to The Light and Champion for bringing the community together and recognizing so much good work across Shelby County. Congratulations to all of this year's honorees.

The recognition is appreciated. The way to honor it is simple: keep listening, explain things clearly, and take good care of our customers and neighbors.

Please help us pass that thank-you along.

The Light and Champion's celebration recap:
https://www.facebook.com/TheLightAndChampion/posts/shelby-countys-best-celebratedto-celebrate-the-winners-in-its-annual-readers-cho/122209653734593001/

posts.facebook:
Good work happens all around Shelby County, often without much fuss.

Congratulations to the businesses, service providers and individuals recognized in The Light and Champion's 2026 Best of the Best awards. It is good to see neighbors receive a thank-you from the people they serve.

There are familiar faces throughout this year's recognition: people who run local shops, answer a call, help a family, or give their time to this community. Each deserves a moment of appreciation for that work.

Thank you to The Light and Champion for organizing the recognition, and to the readers who took the time to vote.

Whether a name appeared on the winners list or not, the everyday work of taking care of neighbors deserves appreciation. Please leave a kind word for a local business or community helper who has made a difference to you.

The Light and Champion's celebration recap:
https://www.facebook.com/TheLightAndChampion/posts/shelby-countys-best-celebratedto-celebrate-the-winners-in-its-annual-readers-cho/122209653734593001/

posts.facebook:
Neighbors helping neighbors is always worth recognizing.

Congratulations to Boo's Battle, named Best Charitable Organization in The Light and Champion's 2026 Best of Shelby County recognition.

The newspaper's celebration recap notes that proceeds from the awards evening's silent auction were donated to Boo's Battle. It is a lovely example of a community celebration making room to support a local organization, too.

Thank you to the readers who voted, to everyone who contributed to that effort, and to The Light and Champion for bringing these community stories together.

This spotlight belongs to Boo's Battle and the neighbors who support its work. Please join us in sending a kind word of congratulations and appreciation.

The Light and Champion's recap, including the Boo's Battle recognition:
